name: LibraryModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Library's window: LibraryCatalog (photos, collections with counts, the selected collection, sort order, the loupe's photo, stepping and position), PhotoItem with its sort orders, metadata edits on the selected photos with mixed values (PhotoMetadata, PhotoFlag) and the metadata inspector's accessibility identifiers (MetadataInspectorID), 60 seeded sample photos, and LibraryThumbnailCache (the grid's held thumbnails, pending requests and size bucket, reading the catalog without changing it and returning failures as availability changes for applyThumbnailFailures), and the status contract (LibraryStatusRow and LibraryStatusPill: the row under the content with its count, selection, cell size or loupe zoom and place, import, render, save and Preview data pills; LibraryInspectorHeader: the inspector's title and facts), and the export contract: export names (ExportNaming+Kernel, an adapter onto SuiteModel's UniqueFileNames) and the Library-local export formats, presets and XMP sidecar (ExportFormats, ExportPresets, ExportSidecar) with the catalog's export methods and runner (LibraryExport), and the menu and key actions (LibraryAction with the catalog's help and run, refusing with the menu's reason as a LibraryRefusal: LibraryActions).
